mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM ddc_metadata_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id AS scope_id, b.id AS biz_id, b.version AS biz_version, n.id AS namespace_id, n.version AS namespace_version, e.id AS env_id, e.version AS env_version, a.id AS app_id, a.version AS app_version, nb.id AS binding_id, nb.version AS binding_version FROM ddc_metadata_scope s JOIN ddc_biz b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.biz_code=s.biz_code AND b.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_env e ON e.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND e.env_code=s.env_code AND e.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_app a ON a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.id=s.app_id AND a.app_code=s.app_code AND a.biz_code=s.biz_code AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_namespace n ON n.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND n.id=s.namespace_id AND n.namespace_code=s.namespace_code AND n.biz_code=s.biz_code AND n.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_namespace_env_app nb ON nb.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND nb.id=s.binding_id AND nb.namespace_id=s.namespace_id AND nb.app_id=s.app_id AND nb.env_code=s.env_code AND nb.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.enabled=true AND e.enabled=true AND a.enabled=true AND n.enabled=true AND nb.enabled=true
mapper.sql: WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND enabled = true AND deleted_at IS NULL
